notes.title: 🔥🛡️ Flak & Hellfire – Two New Towers Enter the Battlefield! ⚔️🎯
notes.content:
This update brings new features, exciting improvements, and some much-needed fixes to the game. Whether you’re battling in PvP or taking on the Singleplayer challenge there are plenty of new reasons to jump back into the fight!

[h2]🏰 New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Tower (Flak):[/b] The perfect tower to defend yourself against air enemies.
[*] [b]Tower (Hellfire):[/b] Starts off slow but keeps firing faster and faster a true powerhouse!
[*] [b]Level Cap:[/b] Player level has been increased from 19 to 21.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ Gameplay & Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New damage indicators:[/b] A sound plays when you take damage, and you’ll now see from which direction it came.
[*] [b]Endless Mode:[/b] Now continues after the last star.
[*] [b]Endless Mode maps:[/b] Certain maps that rarely or never appeared will now spawn correctly.
[*] Incorrect maps in Endless Mode have been fixed.
[*] Tutorial in Singleplayer now works again.
[*] Enemy Mage can once again be targeted by ground towers.
[/list]

[h2]🛡️ PvP Mode[/h2]

[list]
[*] Your base is now marked, making it easier to find.
[*] Sound effects now play correctly in both ears.
[*] Fixed several game crashes.
[*] Music bug after boss fights has been resolved no more silence!
[*] The Win Screen now correctly displays the actual winner of the match.
[*] At the enemy spawn table, the hotbar no longer scrolls along when browsing.
[*] Enemy prices have been reworked and balanced.
[/list]

🔥 Enjoy the update and good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: 🌨️🌍 Snow Planet Expansion
notes.content:

Thanks to all of you for the feedback – you’ve helped us make the game even better!

[list]

[b]Tutorial[/b]

[list]
[*] Enemy waves are back in the tutorial.

[/list]

[b]Reworked Ore Mining[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved visual effects.
[*] New mechanic: hitting specific weak points mines ores faster.
[/list]

[b]Towers & Enemies[/b]

[list]
[*] Teslar Tower now correctly attacks the Dragon – and the Dragon responds as intended.
[*] Blueprint table animations for towers are now faster.
[*] The Logbook now displays in percentages how much more/less damage enemies take from strengths/weaknesses.
[*] Juggernaut had a display error in the logbook.
[*] Some of the texts in the logbook have been adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fix: Enemies could previously be blocked by unfinished “ghost” barricades.

[/list]

[list]
[*] Endless/Campaign selection UI completely reworked.
[*] Save game loading screen redesigned.
[*] Tower selection visuals improved for better clarity.
[*] Ore deposit UI visually polished.
[/list]

[b]Controls & Settings[/b]

[list]
[*] Keybinding changes are now directly reflected on in-game button layouts.
[*] Language selection is now more prominently highlighted in settings.
[/list]

[b]Resource System[/b]

[list]
[*] Crafting: Items are automatically placed into free inventory slots.
[b]Selling:[/b]
[*] Players can now specify the exact amount to sell.
[*] Instant “Sell All” option added (no waiting).
[/list]

[b]Texts[/b]

[list]
[*] Many in-game texts polished and improved.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using emotes while selecting a level could cause errors.
[*] Fixed a bug where some players could not unlock specific upgrades.
[*] Save files can now be deleted correctly.
[*] Improved footstep sounds on metal, sand, and ground surfaces.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
[h2]🚀 Performance[/h2]

[list]
[*] General performance improvements across all hubs and levels.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
[h2]📢 Developer Statement[/h2]

We know you’re used to faster update cycles from us – this update took 2 full months to develop.
The reason is simple: we didn’t just work on this patch. At the same time, we’ve been building the next major update, which is already close to release.

Right now, you have access to the Campaign and the Endless Mode. But soon, we’ll be introducing a third game mode.
This mode required us to reprogram nearly the entire core of the game, as it was never originally planned and turned out to be a huge technical challenge.

We appreciate your patience and hope you’re as excited as we are for what’s coming next. ❤️

notes.title: Drones, Smarter Mining & QoL Improvements 🛠️
notes.content:
[b]Hey space adventurers![/b]
We’re back with another exciting update – thank you so much for your continued support and feedback!
This time, we’re bringing in a major new feature: Drones – and a whole bunch of improvements and fixes.

[h2]🚀 New Content[/h2]

[b]🔧 Drone System[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now craft drones!
[*] Just like the Mobile Miner, they need to be charged before use
[*] Can be placed at a Mobile Miner site
[*] Automatically collect 200 units of each ore
[*] After collecting, they fly back to you and deliver the resources
[/list]

[b]🌌 Ore Farm in Endless Mode[/b]
The Ore Farm is now available in Endless Mode – for infinite resource collection!

[b]⚙️ Toggle Movement Bubbles[/b]
You can now turn off movement bubbles in the settings if you prefer a cleaner look.

[b]✨ Adjustable Particle Effects[/b]
Particle effects can now be adjusted in the settings – choose between better visuals or better performance.

[h2]🧯 Hotfixes & Improvements[/h2]

[b]✅ Fixed double ore placement[/b]
The Ore Farm no longer places two ores in the same spot.

[b]❌ Resources now disappear when Ore Farm is removed[/b]
When dismantling an Ore Farm, its stored resources are now correctly removed.

[b]🌵 Improved cactus collision[/b]
The cactus hitbox has been improved – smoother movement around them.

[b]🔄 Settings renamed[/b]
The “Settings” menu is now labeled “Difficulty” for better clarity.

[b]💥 Tutorial adjustment[/b]
The Exploder has been removed from the tutorial to make the beginning more beginner-friendly.

[b]📈 Player upgrade visuals improved[/b]
Upgrade graphics have been polished and are now clearer and more modern.

[b]⛏️ Skill progress now more noticeable[/b]
Ore mining progress while skilling is now more clearly visible and faster to notice.

[b]🔋 Infinite stamina bug fixed[/b]
Sometimes the Miner had unlimited stamina when starting a level – this is now fixed.

[b]📊 Incorrect miner stats fixed[/b]
Selecting a Miner sometimes displayed the wrong stats – this has been corrected.

We hope you enjoy this update – as always:
Keep the feedback coming, report bugs, and stay tuned for more content! 🚀💎
We’re already working on the next big thing...

notes.title: Major Content and Stability Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear Tower Defense community, [/b]

We took our time, but it was worth it! In addition to the long-awaited base upgrades, we have implemented numerous new features and improvements – including a comprehensive controller overhaul.  

The game has been completely revamped and expanded with many long-awaited features. We’ve also fixed all reported bugs. If you come across any more, feel free to report them in the Steam discussion or via the in-game F1 tool.  

A huge thank you to everyone who supports us and provides regular feedback!

[b]changelog[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
                                                               [b]New[/b]

[b]Base Upgrades:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The base can now be upgraded in the hub.  
[*] Pre-installed turrets are available and can be upgraded in multiple stages.  
[*] More HP can be added to the base.  
[*] A shield can be added to the base.  
[*] Two additional stairs for easier access to the base.  
[/list]

[b]Level Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Level 1, 2 & 3: Extensive rework – large parts of the map have been redesigned to improve graphics.  
[*] Level 4: Additional tower slots added and map errors fixed.  
[*] Level 5: Reduced in size to improve performance and allow for more details.  
[/list]  

[b]Wooden Barricade:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Can be crafted and placed on enemy paths.  
[*] Slows down or blocks enemies.  
[*] Has limited durability and can be destroyed.  
[*] Enemies avoid obstacles when possible.  
[/list]  

[b]Improved Enemy AI:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Enemies now target specific points of the base.  
[*] These attack points are visually indicated.  
[/list]  

[b]Revamped Tower Selection:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The tower selection has been completely redesigned and seamlessly integrated into the game.  
[*] A more intuitive interface allows for more efficient use during gameplay.  
[/list]  

[b]Ping Functionality:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Players can now place pings in the game to communicate important information.  
[*] The middle mouse button allows up to three pings to be placed simultaneously to highlight strategic positions.  
[/list]  

[b]The Logbook has been reworked:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Elite enemies are now displayed as well.  
[*] Additionally, the base upgrade table has been added.  
[/list]

[b]Endless Mode:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] New card added for the wooden barricade.  
[*] New card added for the mobile mining laser.  
[*] Cards now enlarge when over with the mouse/controller.  
[/list]  

[b]UI Optimization:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The info display in the level selection is now collapsed by default and can be expanded via a new button in the upper corner.  
[*] The tower selection area has been removed from this menu and placed in a new UI location.  
[*] The interaction window now opens faster.  
[/list]  

[b]Hub Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Graphical rework of the hub.  
[*] New sound effects & animations.  
[*] Secret location added.  
[*] Reworked relic table.  
[*] Relics now have a floating effect.  
[/list]  

[b]Control Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] We have completely reworked the game controls in the background. While the gameplay may feel unchanged to you, this change was crucial for enabling future features like sneaking or quick-build mode. Previously, key bindings couldn't be used multiple times in different UI sections, which caused issues, especially with controllers. Now, the controls are more flexible and optimized – a big step for future updates!  

[*] Additionally, we’ve laid the foundation for allowing you to adjust UI sizes or hide certain elements entirely in the future. We're continuing to work on this to provide even more customization options!  
[/list]  

[b]Upgraded Towers:[/b]  
Players now receive upgrade ores back based on the HP of upgraded towers.  

[b]New Secrets:[/b]  
An additional relic has been hidden in Levels 4 and 5.

[b]Statistics Overhaul:[/b]  
The escape menu now displays how much XP is needed for the next level in the statistics section.  

[b]Player Upgrades with Description:[/b]  
Before unlocking a player upgrade, a detailed description is now shown, explaining the benefits and effects of the upgrade. This helps you make informed decisions before developing your skills.  

[b]UI Update:[/b]  
The font of the new wave display has been adjusted.  

[b]Trade Improvement:[/b]  
Selling all ores can now be canceled by pressing the same button again.  

[b]Radio:[/b]  
The radio feature has been reworked.  

[b]Translations:[/b]  
If a language is missing translations, the English text will now be displayed instead of an error.  

[b]Tutorial Cutscene:[/b]  
A new indicator in the tutorial now informs players that the cutscene can be skipped by pressing the spacebar.  

[b]Blueprint Table:[/b]  
Now highlights in red if there aren’t enough ores available.  

[b]Voting Tool:[/b]  
Controller icon added.  

[b]Sound Effects Reworked[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Weapon shot sound: New  
[*] Weapon reload sound: New  
[*] Mining laser sound: New  
[*] Overworld spaceship hover sound: New  
[*] Out-of-ammo sound: New  
[*] Weapon switch sound: New  
[*] Rocket launcher explosion sound: New  
[*] Gatling gun shot sound: New  
[/list]

[b]Inventory[/b]
The quantity of items in the inventory is now also displayed in the hotbar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]  

[list]  
[*] The difficulty in Endless Mode has been adjusted to make it challenging but not impossible.  
[*] The "Deposit Ores" task has been removed in Levels 4 and 5 to significantly speed up the progression in these stages.  
[*] Railgun: Costs reduced from 800 units of ore to 150 units per ore.  
[*] Rocket Launcher: Costs adjusted from 750 units of ore to 300 units of turquoise ore and 400 units of purple ore.  
[*] The Elite 1 Exploder was previously three times as fast but has now been reduced to double speed. This allows it to be attacked more easily by other turrets, improving the balance.  
[*] The explosion resistance of the Elite 1 Slime has been removed.  
[*] The Elite 1 Mushroom is now resistant to fire.  
[*] In Endless Mode, the map that grants +5% damage for every nearby turret has been adjusted. Instead of -5%, the same turret now only gets -2.5%.  
[*] Some enemies have been removed from the tutorial to make it easier.  
[/list]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]Bugs[/b]  

[list]  
[*] In multiplayer mode, the player could no longer move in the base (hub) in certain situations. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] In the tutorial, it was possible to get stuck when leaving the level during an active tutorial animation. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] If an error occurred during saving, the save file would be reset. This problem has been fixed.  
[*] The flickering of lights in some levels occasionally occurred and has now been corrected.  
[*] Tower upgrades were not updated after crafting. This was just a display issue, which has now been fixed.  
[*] Player icons were no longer displayed on the compass. This problem has been fixed.  
[*] In the deposit terminal, the wave display overlapped in the UI. This has been corrected.  
[*] A display error related to the wave display has been fixed.  
[*] The term "Level" has been renamed to "Wave" to better reflect the game mechanics and flow.  
[*] The voting system can no longer be used in the UI, as it previously caused crashes and disruptions.  
[*] A visual issue, where "::" was displayed during tower upgrades, has been fixed.  
[*] The robot skin was not always displayed in the character selection in the lobby. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] The poison zone in Level 1 has been adjusted to better balance the gameplay.  
[*] Previously, only hosts could see the visual effects when an enemy was frozen. This has been fixed, so all players can now see the effects.  
[*] The issue with keybinds for weapon firing has been fixed.  
[*] The unwanted counting of stars in the Endless Mode tutorial for achievements has been removed.  
[*] A problem has been fixed where players would sometimes get stuck after their base was destroyed.  
[*] A bug where the level animation wouldn't continue after the base was destroyed has been fixed. This issue no longer occurs.  
[*] The hand animation of the build sequence has been adjusted so it no longer appears in the hub. This should permanently fix the issue.  
[*] The controller now works again in multiplayer.  
[*] The game start button is now usable with the controller again.  
[*] The back button in the game settings now works with the controller.  
[*] Controller keybinds can now be opened in the settings using the controller.  
[*] The lobby is now accessible again with the controller.  
[*] The player upgrade table now works with the controller again.  
[*] The level display now works again with the controller.  
[*] Endless mode maps can now be selected with the controller again.  
[*] The back button in level selection now works again with the controller.  
[*] The workbench now works again with the controller.  
[*] The tower upgrade UI is now controllable with the controller again.  
[*] Targeting can now be done with the controller again.  
[*] In the build menu, it was possible to move out with the controller, causing the player to get stuck. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] Skipping waves now works with the controller again.  
[*] While in the tower upgrade UI, players can no longer walk around.  
[*] The voting system now works again with the controller.  
[*] When using a controller, waves were sometimes spawned unexpectedly faster. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] Various spelling errors have been corrected.  
[*] In the settings, opening the logbook caused an overlap in the UI. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] In Endless Mode, the new wave display continued to show while selecting maps. This display has now been removed.  
[*] When briefly using the mining laser, the displayed number incorrectly jumped from 99 to 100. This behavior has been corrected.  
[*] Player upgrade level 15 is currently unreachable. Therefore, a placeholder with "WIP" and a question mark has been temporarily implemented.  
[*] If an info text was displayed in multiplayer and the window wasn't clicked away, the player could fly upwards. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] It was possible to move the health display if the tower or enemy was hit precisely, causing some enemies to have no health display. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] A bug was fixed where the mobile miner was duplicated if the building menu was opened during placement.  
[*] A graphic error related to the relic in Level 3 has been fixed.  
[*] If the base was destroyed in the tutorial, it remained at 0 HP without effect. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] Collision errors on the base have been fixed. 
[*] Tower upgrades now reappear in the list when using the cancel button.
[*] The interaction UI is now hidden in the background when crafting in the tower.

[/list]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

We look forward to more feedback and wish you lots of fun while playing!

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,  
Your Stellarcraft Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/4467f0d33e5b4ed06a0080c6c3221b1cbd047da2.gif[/img]

An exception are crafting items, which are needed to build and upgrade your towers and can also be collected in Endless Mode.

These optimizations not only improve the game's visual aesthetics but also contribute to a noticeable boost in performance. Experience Stellarcraft in a whole new light and enjoy the enhanced look and feel!

The Halloween themes and graphics have been removed from Stellarcraft following the end of the event. The game is now returning to its classic look, focusing on upcoming updates and new content.
